messages:
cass: Heads-up: Alex was part of a role elimination today. Employment ends 2026-10-15 but manager requested a 2-week garden leave (paid) until 2026-10-29. Need a special offboard plan: preserve email for garden leave, restrict production infra, keep laptop for WFH, and send COBRA packet.

drew: I can do the staged deprovisioning. Proposed plan:
  1) Freeze prod access (remove deploy rights) immediately
  2) Keep SSO active but disable admin roles during garden leave
  3) Revoke PATs and personal keys on final day 2026-10-29
  4) Rotate shared secrets after garden leave ends

cass: Sounds good. Also HR: confirm garden-leave pay paperwork and benefits continuation dates. We'll need a written agreement signed.

payroll: Confirmed: garden-leave paid through 2026-10-29, benefits remain active through 2026-10-31 (EOM). COBRA packet scheduled 2026-10-30 with opt-in info. Final payroll processed after 10/29.

alex: I can be available during garden leave for knowledge transfer. I prefer keeping laptop to work remotely. I accept access restrictions on prod but need read-only dashboards and email.

drew: OK. I'll create IT ticket and set access flags: read-only for monitoring, disabled deploy tokens, removed from oncall rotations. If Alex needs temporary elevated access, we'll route via jumpbox with approval and time limit.

it-ops-bot: IT ticket created: HR-9999 "Alex role-elim + garden leave access plan". Assigned to Drew. ETA initial actions 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

cass: Also capture any sole-admin SaaS ownerships and transfer now. If any downstream billing owner is Alex, reassign immediately.

alex: I'm sole billing owner on one analytics account. I'll add Cass and Drew now. Also will put a short handoff doc in the shared drive.

drew: After garden leave ends on 10/29 at 17:00 UTC we will: disable SSO, revoke PATs/SSH keys, remove from Slack org, and schedule device pickup or prepaid label per Alex preference.

cass: Alex prefers to return laptop by prepaid label. We'll confirm address and send label 10/30. HR to send separation agreement and COBRA packet 10/30.

alex: Thanks all. Appreciate the clear plan. Happy to do two 30-min handoffs during garden leave. :handshake:
